question: Across every complete no-movement farend_singletalk pair in the exact pinned Interspeech2021 blind-test tree, how broadly does the unchanged Activity implementation observe pure-far mic/reference energy evidence that activates public DTD, without changing or searching any threshold?

source.rating_formula: last half of each common-length mic+lpb clip

selection.rule: all GUIDs at the exact source revision that have both GUID_farend_singletalk_lpb.wav and GUID_farend_singletalk_mic.wav; exclude every with_movement file; no result-dependent filtering

inventory_binding.method: enumerate the exact Git tree before LFS materialization; for every selected path bind the Git LFS pointer oid sha256 and size into a sealed runtime inventory artifact

ci_resource_guard.authority: execution-resource-only; never an acoustic, quality, DTD, or selection boundary

observation_method.independent_energy_cross_check: compare EMA-recovered instant-ratio evidence against input_rms_dbfs plus synced internal reference energy on every official-rating frame

outputs: sealed all-complete-pair LFS inventory and fingerprint
per-case public DTD fraction when the current synced reference itself exceeds the existing far threshold
per-case smoothed and instant mic/reference ratio summaries
the predecessor 49II and 7GT cases as named anchors only if naturally present in the all-pair inventory
prohibited_actions: subsample cases after observing audio or diagnostic results
replace the all-complete-pair rule with a hand-picked subset
derive or search a DTD threshold
derive or search a gain-normalization constant
change the current 1.5, 0.90, 0.72, 1e-7, or 3-frame Activity constants
revive I009 echo-normalized or residual-echo rescue
relax pure-far, movement, echo-path-change, Hosted Real AEC, or other qualification gates
promote to HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: This coverage run may establish whether the current pure-far false-DTD energy-ratio mechanism is isolated or broadly observable across the pinned real far-end corpus. It cannot identify the physical cause of mic/reference gain differences, define a detector boundary, or authorize a source candidate.
